title: Beacon Lens Manifest
description: The JSON object inside a lens file's <script type="application/beacon-lens+json"> element (lenses/v1).

id.description: Stable identity. Unique on the endpoint; built-in lens IDs are reserved.

description.description: One or two sentences shown in the lens picker. One line.

icon.description: One generic word naming an icon. The dashboard falls back to a default icon for a word it does not know.

version.description: Lens content revision; bump on every change.

api.description: The data contract the lens was written against.
